title: ranunculus montanus var. alpicola
intro: Ranunculus montanus var. alpicola, commonly known as Alpine Buttercup, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, thanks to its health benefits in promoting wound healing and soothing irritated skin. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Buttercup are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include ranunculin, a toxic compound that has shown potential in inhibiting cancer cell growth, as well as other bioactive compounds that exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
